title: Design Phase 4 reliability, token efficiency, and model routing
scope: Define the accepted Phase 4 contracts for durability and recovery, adversarial policy evaluation, multi-repository federation, operational metrics, token attribution, and policy-constrained model routing before feature implementation.
acceptance_criteria: The design separates canonical project truth, rebuildable telemetry, portfolio projections, and external provider authority.
Token accounting uses provider-reported metadata or local deterministic estimates without invoking another model solely for measurement.
Usage can be attributed by project, Work Item, Position, lifecycle stage, Agent task, provider, and model when those dimensions are available, while unknown remains explicit.
Model routing defines defaults, allowed overrides, capability and risk constraints, human spending boundaries, fallback behavior, and reproducibility metadata without promising automatic savings.
Phase 4A, 4B, and 4C each have implementation boundaries, exit evidence, retained validations, and explicit exclusions.
The documentation index and ADR index route readers to the accepted design, and repository checks pass.
